pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: SELECT b.claimno AS "CaseID", b.nopolis AS "NoKTP", b.qqname AS "ClaimID", b.picteknik AS "ConsultantName", (select businessgroupname from POOLDATA.BUSINESS where id=B.BUSINESSCODE) AS "ClaimNo", b.businessname AS "Resources", b.sobname as "IsPLA", c.nama_mo AS "IsSendPremi", b.leader_member AS "UserTeknisEmail", b.NOREFBROKER as "NoReffBroker", b.STS_BANDING as "Banding", b.STS_KEPUASAN as "SurveyKepuasan", b.EFFORT_CLOSE as "EffortClose", b.KENDALA_CLOSE as "KendalaClose", b.STS_PAPERLESS as "Paperless", b.USULAN as "Usulan", (select causeofloss from pooldata.t_claim_objectcoverage where claimid=b.claimid and objectid=a.objectid and objectcoverageid=a.objectcoverageid) as "InsuredName", (select coveragename from pooldata.t_claim_objectcoverage where claimid=b.claimid and objectid=a.objectid and objectcoverageid=a.objectcoverageid) as "TelpTertanggung", (DECODE (b.exgratia, '0', 'NO', NULL, 'NO','1','YES')) AS "AnalystRemaksInvestigator", CASE WHEN b.grouppanel in ('003','009') THEN (select occupationid from pooldata.t_anekalist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and indexobject=a.objectid and rownum=1) WHEN b.grouppanel='006' THEN (SELECT cc.OccupationCode FROM pooldata.t_propertylist z, JSON_TABLE (z.OCCUPATIONLIST, '$' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.OccupationList[*]' COLUMNS (OccupationCode varchar2 path '$.OccupationCode'))) cc WHERE z.nopolis=b.nopolis and z.INDEXOBJECT=a.objectid and z.prodke=b.prodke and rownum='1') ELSE (select goodsid from pooldata.t_cargolist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and goodsid=a.objectid and rownum='1') END AS "UserTeknis", CASE WHEN b.grouppanel in ('003','009') THEN (select occupationname from pooldata.t_anekalist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and indexobject=a.objectid and rownum=1) WHEN b.grouppanel='006' THEN (SELECT dd.OccupationName FROM pooldata.t_propertylist x, JSON_TABLE (x.OCCUPATIONLIST, '$' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.OccupationList[*]' COLUMNS (OccupationName varchar2 path '$.OccupationName'))) dd WHERE x.nopolis=b.nopolis and x.INDEXOBJECT=a.objectid and x.prodke=b.prodke and rownum='1') ELSE (select goodsname from pooldata.t_cargolist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and goodsid=a.objectid and rownum='1') END AS "UserName", to_char(c.begindate,'rrrr') as "Remark", to_char(c.begindate,'dd/mm/yyyy') as "RCV_ID", to_char(c.enddate,'dd/mm/yyyy') as "RW", to_char(b.dateofloss,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "CountryID", to_char(b.dateofloss, 'mm') AS "AreaClaimId", to_char(b.dateofloss, 'yyyy') AS "ContractNo", to_char(b.registerdate,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "Country", to_char(a.analyst_tfkomitedate,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "Email", to_char(A.ACCEPTANCE_DATECOMITEE,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "District", to_char(a.tglakseptasi,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "AlasanKlaim", to_char(d.CLOSECLAIMDATE_1,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "Conveyance", to_char(d.CLOSECLAIMDATE_1,'mm') AS "month CopyFrom", to_char(d.CLOSECLAIMDATE_1,'yyyy') AS "year CreateFrom", to_char(b.ANALYST_TRANSFERDATE,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "EmailTertanggung", round(datamining.get_working_hours@asmd.sinarmas.co.id(b.registerdate, b.closeclaimdate) / 28800,0) as "ExGratiaNote", round(datamining.get_working_hours@asmd.sinarmas.co.id(a.receivedatelod, a.transfer_cashier_date) / 28800,0) as "FlagASO", CASE WHEN d.SURVEYORTYPE_1 IN ('2','3','4') THEN d.Adjusterpic_1 ELSE '' END AS "FlagNOLL", CASE WHEN d.SURVEYORTYPE_1 = '1' AND b.businessname ='MARINE HULL' THEN d.SURVEYORNAME_1 WHEN d.SURVEYORTYPE_1 = '2' AND b.businessname ='MARINE HULL' THEN d.SURVEYORNAMEMARINE_1 ELSE '' END AS "FlagReject", (SELECT CURRENCY FROM POOLDATA.CURRENCY WHERE ID = A.CURRENCY) AS "NPWP", CASE WHEN a.paymenttype in ('1','2','5') THEN (SELECT SUM (ESTIMATIONVALUE) FROM POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_ESTIMASI WHERE claimid = a.claimid AND estimationtype = '1' AND kursid = a.currency and a.objectid=objectid and a.objectcoverageid=objectcoverageid and cfsdate<=trunc(a.ANALYST_TFKOMITEDATE)) WHEN a.paymenttype ='4' THEN (SELECT SUM (ESTIMATIONVALUE) FROM POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_ESTIMASI WHERE claimid = a.claimid AND estimationtype = '2' AND kursid = a.currency and a.objectid=objectid and a.objectcoverageid=objectcoverageid and cfsdate<=trunc(a.ANALYST_TFKOMITEDATE)) ELSE 0 END AS "ProdKe", a.noakseptasi AS "DistrictID", a.ASM_SHARE AS "ASMShare", a.LOSS_ADJUSTER_FEE as "LDR_NOTE", a.LOSS_ADJUSTER_FEE*(a.ASM_SHARE/100) as "LDR_ID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE AS "KomiteStatus", a.PROPOSE_VALUE AS "OldNoHp", a.LOSS_ADJUSTER_FEE as "LOSS_ADJUSTER_FEE", a.LOSS_ADJUSTER_FEE*(a.ASM_SHARE/100) as "LOSS_ADJUSTER_FEE", DECODE(a.paymenttype,'1','Final','2','Interim','3','Salvage','4','Adjuster Fee','5','Adjustment','6','Tolak Klaim') as "IBNR", a.GROSSVALUE AS "Currency", CASE WHEN ASM_SHARE = 100 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "Status", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_BPPDAN AS "LossCoverage", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FAC_OUT AS "LokasiSurveyor", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_QS_RI AS "IsTransferPIC", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FSPL as "AnaylstRemarks", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSRSPL as "AnalystDoctorRemaks", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSPLNSRI AS "NIK", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSRQS_RI as "BranchID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FESPL AS "IsAnalisTransfer", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FAC_OBL as "BranchName", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FACOBSRB as "BusinessID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FACOBINDT as "CASEDB", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_ER1 as "CauseOfLoss", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_ER2 as "CauseOfLossID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSS AS "City", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PRGBI AS "CityID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PFRA AS "ClientID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_XL AS "ClientName", CASE WHEN a.paymenttype in ('1','2','5') THEN ((select sum(estimationvalue) from t_claim_estimasi where a.claimid=claimid and a.objectid=objectid and a.objectcoverageid=objectcoverageid and estimationtype='1' and kursid = a.currency and cfsdate<=trunc(a.ANALYST_TFKOMITEDATE)) - a.nilaiakseptasi) WHEN a.paymenttype in ('4') THEN ((select sum(estimationvalue) from t_claim_estimasi where a.claimid=claimid and a.objectid=objectid and a.objectcoverageid=objectcoverageid and estimationtype='2' and kursid = a.currency and cfsdate<=trunc(a.ANALYST_TFKOMITEDATE)) - a.nilaiakseptasi) ELSE 0 END as "IDMaster", c.TSI AS "IdxSurveyResults", b.leader_member AS "DaftarObjek", (SELECT I.STS_PROGRESS1 FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G , POOLDATA.GCNM_MST_PROGRESS_KLAIM I WHERE G.STATUS_PROGRESS1 = I.ID_PROGRESS AND G.PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = (SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE)FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2','24','60','59'))) AS "AgingAmount", (select POOLDATA.GET_POSISI_PROGRESS2(G.PNCCASEID,G.ID_UPDATE,G.JSONSTATUS_PROGRESS2 ) from POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G where c.NOKLAIM = G.PNCCASEID AND ID_UPDATE = (SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE)FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2','24','60','59'))) AS "AlasanTerlambat", (SELECT TO_CHAR(G.TGL_INPUT,'DD/MM/YY') FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G WHERE G.PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = (SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE)FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2','24','60','59'))) AS "ReceiverClaim", (SELECT G.KETERANGAN FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G WHERE G.PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = (SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE)FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2','24','60','59'))) AS "pyNote", (SELECT TO_CHAR(G.NEXT_FOLLOWUP,'DD/MM/YYYY') FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM G WHERE G.PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM AND ID_UPDATE = (SELECT MAX(ID_UPDATE)FROM POOLDATA.GCNM_PROGRESS_CLAIM WHERE PNCCASEID = c.NOKLAIM and STATUS_PROGRESS2 not in ('2','24','60','59'))) AS "StatusReceiver", B.COINSNAME as "OwnRisk", (select NOTE_ST from POOLDATA.MST_PENOLAKAN_KLAIM_2 where ID_ST=A.IDPENOLAKANST and ID_ND=A.IDPENOLAKANDUA) as "KodeCabang", (select NOTE_ND from POOLDATA.MST_PENOLAKAN_KLAIM_2 where ID_ST=A.IDPENOLAKANST and ID_ND=A.IDPENOLAKANDUA) as "KodeKBRU", case when K.STATUSAPPROVE='1' then 'Approved' when K.STATUSAPPROVE='2' then 'Rejected' else 'Waiting' end as "StatusApprove", K.KOMITE_ID as "ClaimNoExt", k.NAMAKOMITE as "NamaPrincipal", K.NOTEKOMITE as "KomiteAccepted" FROM pooldata.t_claim_adjustment a, pooldata.t_claim_pnc b, pooldata.pega_dashboardpnc c, datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work d, POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_KOMITE_LIST k WHERE a.claimid = b.claimid AND b.claimno = c.noklaim AND b.claimid=d.pzinskey and D.PYID=K.NO_KLAIM and A.CASEIDKOMITE=K.KOMITE_ID AND b.branchname != 'ASNET' AND b.grouppanel IN ('003', '004', '006', '009') AND b.businesscode NOT IN ('10145', '10168', '10165', '10164', '10053', '10075', '10126', '10011', '10077', '10007') and K.KOMITE_ID in (select f.komite_id from POOLDATA.T_CLAIM_KOMITE_LIST f where F.STATUSAPPROVE={TempDataPending.StatusApprove} and F.NO_KLAIM=D.PYID) {ASIS:TempDataPending.NoteKasir} AND TRUNC (d.CLOSECLAIMDATE_1) >= TO_DATE ({TempLaporan.AnalystTransferDate}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AND TRUNC (d.CLOSECLAIMDATE_1) <= TO_DATE ({TempLaporan.DateOfLoss}, 'dd/mm/yyyy') ORDER BY d.CLOSECLAIMDATE_1 ASC
